summary: Constructed a finite countermodel for the proposed discriminator that complete joint sufficiency of every causal record plus matched two-input public response determines the number of graph foundations. Reused #744's finite single-source graph, but changed only hidden root occurrence to the conjunction of the two scenario bits so every root-to-input record becomes sufficient; reused #735's plural exercise unchanged. The Lean certificate proves all four public truth-table rows match, all-record sufficiency, coherence, two contributor indispensability, inductive Supply, least/common source in the strengthened single control versus neither in the plural control, and the original single fixture's counterexample to all-record sufficiency. The models have distinct hidden carriers and record structures; no real-world causal or modal equivalence is claimed. The new theorem compiled and its hosted Comparator shard passed in PR #974 at commit ef0a6323ba10fdf12f08ff2f667f481c5c4cca65. Full-library and independent NanoDa validation are separate final CI gates.
blocker: Philosophical bridge OPEN: explain why supplied scenario sufficiency corresponds to genuine productive/per se explanation rather than regular co-occurrence, without presupposing uniqueness, and apply that criterion to both the single and plural models. No root premise discharged.
